title: Window Thermal Mat 2-Pack 70 × 80 cm – Insulation Against Cold and Sun
seo_title: Window Thermal Mat 2-Pack 70 × 80 cm – Cold and Sun
seo_description: 2 silver thermal mats, 70 × 80 cm each, with suction cups for caravan windows. Roll them up when not in use.
descriptionHtml:
The cold from the window is felt all the way into your sleeping bag

The cold radiates straight in through the caravan window as soon as the night turns cold, and you feel it even with the duvet pulled up. In the daytime it's the opposite – the same glass lets the sun in until the cabin gets stuffy long before lunch.

2 mats that suction straight onto the window

Two silver thermal mats, 70 × 80 cm each, are placed against the inside of the window and held in place with suction cups. The mat is rolled up and put away when it's not needed.

Features

  • 2 mats in the pack – one for each window, 70 × 80 cm each
  • Keeps the cold and the sun off the window – silver insulating mat placed against the glass
  • Stays on without tape or screws – suction cups hold the mat in place
  • Takes no space when the season is over – the mat is rolled up and put away
